description.value:
Source: Arcforge Players Compendium

Prerequisites: Conjuration sphere, Tinker sphere ((computation) package).

Benefit: When you summon your companion, you may summon it as an AI rather than a manifested creature. In order to summon an AI companion, you must have an eligible gizmo or other item (if you possess the Adaptable Transfer* feat) within range of the summon. An AI version of a companion has the same skill ranks, mental ability scores, base saves, spheres, talents, and feats of the companion. An AI companion can take its normal suite of actions each round without needing you to spend additional actions commanding it regardless of its Intelligence score.

Special: If you possess the Call Planar Creature talent, you may transform a called creature into an AI once it agrees to your terms. An AI version of a called creature has the same skill ranks, mental ability scores, base saves, spheres, talents, spells, spell-like abilities, and feats of the creature. An AI companion can take its normal suite of actions each round without needing you to spend additional actions commanding it regardless of its Intelligence score.

If you possess the Hostile Takeover feat, you may attempt to summon an AI companion into an unwilling or attended object. The target or its owner is allowed a saving throw to resist the effect against your Conjuration sphere DC, and the AI companion is not summoned on a successful save.

Source: Spheres of Power Wiki
